items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Trim Targets
items.summary: Applied Materials is back in focus after a reassessment of its fair value, which has moved from about US$620.78 to roughly US$557.86, a reduction of around 10% in the latest price target work. Analysts link this shift to sector wide multiple compression and updated expectations for wafer fabrication equipment spending, even as they continue to highlight AI and capacity expansion as long term themes. Read on to see how these moving pieces shape the current narrative and how you can track...
